name: agent_desktop
description: Observe and interact with Linux desktop application windows via native AT-SPI OS accessibility trees, semantic @refs, and high-speed batch sequences without vision models.

action.description: The desktop action to perform via AT-SPI accessibility engine.

app.description: Optional application name to scope snapshot or launch (e.g. 'chrome', 'nemo', 'terminal').

window_id.description: Optional window ID to scope snapshot or focus (from list_windows).

ref.description: Target @ref ID from accessibility tree snapshot (e.g. '@s201xook5z7c16:e13').

text.description: Text payload to type into targeted @ref input field.

value.description: Semantic value payload for instant set_value injection (~1ms).

option.description: Option to select in a dropdown or list.

from.description: Source @ref or coordinate for drag start.

to.description: Target @ref or coordinate for drag destination.

key.description: Keyboard key symbol to press or hotkey combo (e.g. 'Return', 'Escape', 'Control+s').

query.description: Query or selector string for find action.

property.description: Element property to retrieve with get action (e.g. 'name', 'value', 'role').

state.description: Element state to check with is action (e.g. 'visible', 'enabled', 'focused').

wait_for.description: Duration in ms or selector to wait for.

batch.description: Array of command objects for atomic/sequential execution in one turn: [{command: 'click', args: ['@ref']}, ...].

stop_on_error.description: Stop executing batch on first error (default: false).

headed.description: Prefer physical delivery instead of headless semantic delivery.

interactive_only.description: Filter snapshot to interactive elements only (-i flag). Defaults to true.
